entries.head: fly back

senses.en: to return by plane

example.en: We fly back on Sunday night.
example.zh: 我们周日晚上的飞机回来。

entries.l1_note: 飞回是 fly back；回来是 come back，别混。

entries.head: check through

senses.en: when bags are sent all the way to the final stop

example.en: Can you check my bags through to Chengdu?
example.zh: 我的行李能直挂到成都吗？

entries.l1_note: 行李直挂是 check through (to)；check in 是办登机。
collocations: check through to the final stop

entries.head: fill out

senses.en: to complete a form

example.en: Fill out the arrival card before you reach the counter.
example.zh: 到柜台前把入境卡填好。

entries.l1_note: 美式填表是 fill out；英式才说 fill in。

entries.head: book into

senses.en: to arrange for someone to stay at a hotel

example.en: The company booked us into a place near the airport.
example.zh: 公司把我们订在机场附近。

entries.l1_note: 订进某处是 book into；book 单独是预订。

entries.head: look forward to

senses.en: to feel happy about something that will happen

example.en: I'm looking forward to three days with no meetings.
example.zh: 我盼着三天不开会。

entries.l1_note: to 后面接名词或 doing，不能接动词原形。

entries.head: count down

senses.en: to wait for something by counting the time left

example.en: We're counting down the days to the holiday.
example.zh: 我们在数着日子等放假。

entries.l1_note: 倒计时是 count down；名词是 countdown。

entries.head: jet off

senses.en: to fly somewhere, especially for pleasure

example.en: They jetted off to Bangkok for the long weekend.
example.zh: 小长假他们飞曼谷去了。

entries.l1_note: jet off 带一点羡慕或调侃，新闻和口语都常见。

entries.head: crash out

senses.en: to fall asleep immediately from exhaustion

example.en: I crashed out as soon as we got to the hotel.
example.zh: 一到酒店我就倒头睡了。

entries.l1_note: 倒头睡是 crash out；crash 单独是撞车、崩溃。

entries.head: nod off

senses.en: to fall asleep without meaning to

example.en: I nodded off on the train and missed my stop.
example.zh: 我在火车上打瞌睡坐过站了。

entries.l1_note: 打瞌睡是 nod off；点头是 nod。

entries.head: sleep in

senses.en: to get up later than usual on purpose

example.en: We slept in and missed breakfast.
example.zh: 我们睡过头，早饭都没了。

entries.l1_note: 睡懒觉是 sleep in（美式）；英式说 lie in。

entries.head: wake up

senses.en: to stop sleeping

example.en: I woke up at four because of the jet lag.
example.zh: 时差让我四点就醒了。

entries.l1_note: 醒来是 wake up；起床是 get up。

entries.head: print out

senses.en: to produce a paper copy

example.en: Print out the booking in case they ask for it.
example.zh: 把订单打出来，万一要查。

entries.l1_note: 打印出来是 print out；print off 也能用。

entries.head: wander around

senses.en: to walk around without a plan

example.en: We wandered around the old town for two hours.
example.zh: 我们在老城随便逛了两小时。

entries.l1_note: 随便逛是 wander around；look around 更偏“看看”。

entries.head: land in

senses.en: when a plane arrives at a place

example.en: We land in Tokyo at six in the morning.
example.zh: 我们早上六点落地东京。

entries.l1_note: 降落在某地是 land in；land at 接机场。

entries.head: check over

senses.en: to examine something carefully

example.en: Check over your passport and visa before you leave.
example.zh: 出门前把护照签证检查一遍。

entries.l1_note: 检查一遍是 check over；check out 是退房。

entries.head: load up

senses.en: to put things into a vehicle

example.en: Load up the car while I check out.
example.zh: 我退房，你装车。

entries.l1_note: 装车是 load up；load 单独是装载。

entries.head: check off

senses.en: to mark items as done on a list

example.en: Check off each sight as you go.
example.zh: 去一个就勾掉一个。

entries.l1_note: 勾掉是 check off；check out 是结账离开。

entries.head: head out

senses.en: to leave to go somewhere

example.en: We're heading out at seven to catch the train.
example.zh: 我们七点出门赶火车。

entries.l1_note: 出门是 head out；head for 是朝某地去。

entries.head: start out

senses.en: to begin a journey

example.en: We started out before sunrise to avoid traffic.
example.zh: 我们天亮前出发躲堵车。

entries.l1_note: start out 也可指“起初是”，比如 start out as a teacher。

entries.head: drop in

senses.en: to visit briefly, often without planning

example.en: Drop in if you're near the hotel.
example.zh: 离酒店近的话过来坐坐。

entries.l1_note: drop in 是不请自来；drop off 是放下。

entries.head: pop in

senses.en: to go in somewhere for a short time

example.en: I'll pop in and grab a coffee before the tour.
example.zh: 参观前我进去买杯咖啡。

entries.l1_note: pop in 强调“快去快回”，比 drop in 更轻。

entries.head: put through

senses.en: to connect a phone call to someone

example.en: Could you put me through to room 1208?
example.zh: 能帮我转到 1208 房吗？

entries.l1_note: 转接是 put through to；不是 connect to（也可但少）。

entries.head: hold on

senses.en: to wait, especially on the phone

example.en: Hold on — I'll check if the room is ready.
example.zh: 稍等，我看下房间好没好。

entries.l1_note: 别挂是 hold on；抓住是 hold onto。

entries.head: hang on

senses.en: to wait for a short time

example.en: Hang on, I left my key at the desk.
example.zh: 等一下，我钥匙落前台了。

entries.l1_note: hang on 和 hold on 基本同义；挂电话是 hang up。

entries.head: book out

senses.en: when all rooms or seats are reserved

example.en: The whole hotel is booked out for the expo.
example.zh: 展会期间酒店全订满了。

entries.l1_note: 订满是 be booked out；book up 也能用。

entries.head: stay in

senses.en: to remain indoors

example.en: We stayed in and ordered room service.
example.zh: 我们没出门，叫了客房送餐。

entries.l1_note: 待在室内是 stay in；stay over 是过夜。

entries.head: go out

senses.en: to leave home for fun

example.en: We went out for dinner and a walk by the river.
example.zh: 我们出去吃了饭，又沿河走了走。

entries.l1_note: 出门玩是 go out；go out with 是谈恋爱。

entries.head: hold over

senses.en: to delay something to a later time

example.en: The flight was held over until the storm passed.
example.zh: 航班延到暴风雨过去。

entries.l1_note: 延期是 hold over；hold up 是耽搁/举起。

entries.head: call ahead

senses.en: to phone before you arrive

example.en: Call ahead if you'll be after ten.
example.zh: 十点以后到的话先打个电话。

entries.l1_note: 提前打电话是 call ahead；call back 是回电。

entries.head: doze off

senses.en: to fall into a light sleep

example.en: I dozed off during the safety video.
example.zh: 放安全视频的时候我打了个盹。

entries.l1_note: doze off 和 nod off 近似；doze 是打盹。
